Answer: C
Reason: Figure 1 shows a visible visceral pleural line with absent lung markings peripherally in the right hemithorax (indicated by arrows), which is diagnostic of a pneumothorax. This finding explains the sudden clinical worsening and pleuritic pain, distinguishing it from pneumonia or ARDS which would present with opacities rather than hyperlucency and a pleural line.
